EMBED_DESCRIPTION:
Guild guardians defend your guild in GvG. Best stats win
`sgg <position> <code>` to set • `sgg <position>` to clear
`sgg commander <code>` to set your commander • `sgg commander` to clear
If the commander takes a 5-star hit, the attacker's guild gets a bonus star. It's also the only slot allowed to hold an `ethereal`-element card
CLEAR_COMMANDER_LEAD_ONLY: > **Ask a Founder or Guildmaster to clear the commander**
COMMANDER_OCCUPIED: > **The commander slot is already occupied. Ask a Founder or Guildmaster**
CARD_NOT_OWNED: > **You do not own a card with that code**
SELECTED_CARD: > **Your currently selected card cannot be used as a guardian**
COMMANDER_OWNS_GUARDIAN: > **You already have a card set as a regular guardian. Clear that first**
INVALID_POSITION: > **Position must be a number between 1 and 10**
CLEAR_POSITION_LEAD_ONLY: > **Ask a Founder or Guildmaster to clear a position**
POSITION_OCCUPIED: > **Position {{position}} is already occupied. Try another position**
ETHEREAL: > **Ethereal cards can only be placed in the commander slot** — `sgg commander <code>`
ONE_GUARDIAN: > **You can only have 1 card set as a guild guardian at a time**
OWNS_COMMANDER: > **You already have a card set as commander. Clear that first**
